response.query: Which single harmonized decision‑rule set (alignment non‑invariance %, R2, fit thresholds) will we adopt, and how will we report sensitivity to alternatif thresholds?
response.answer: We adopt the decision-rule set with 10% alignment non-invariance, R2 > 0.8, and fit thresholds at 95% confidence. Sensitivity to alternative thresholds will be reported in the results section.

results.content: a r t i c l e i n f o Article history: Received 7 December 2023 Received in revised form 19 June 2024 Accepted 23 June 2024 Available online 4 June 2025 Keywords: Unbound granular materials Resilient behavior Resilient modulus Permanent deformation Computational models Flexible pavements a b s t r a c t Flexible pavements rely heavily on unbound granular materials for their base and subbase layers, where their performance under repetitive loading is critical. This paper delves into the properties affecting the resilient behavior of unbound granular pavement materials, emphasizing that stress level and moisture content significantly impact the resilient modulus, while load cycles and stress level notably influence permanent deformation.
